name: Webtop
tagline: Full Linux desktop in the browser
description: Alpine/Ubuntu desktop environments streamed to your browser over HTML5 — a complete remote desktop without any client software.
compose:
services:
  webtop:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/webtop:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
